book.name: XHUN
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U XHAN Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Aꞌ u Jesús u bꞌeyeꞌ tiꞌ toon unqꞌa tenameꞌ kꞌatz u Tiixheꞌ
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Yeꞌ kuxh exaansa etaama. As ekꞌujbꞌaꞌtaj ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ. As ekꞌujbꞌaꞌtaj ekꞌuꞌl sviꞌ unpajte,
tan nimal atinbꞌal ati xeꞌ vunBꞌaaleꞌ. As jitꞌeꞌch kojeꞌ, as yeꞌleꞌxh la val sete. Pet bꞌen in tiꞌ unbꞌanat isuuchil vetatinbꞌaleꞌ kꞌatz u Kubꞌaaleꞌ.
As tul uvaꞌ la bꞌen in, as la bꞌen unbꞌan isuuchil vetatinbꞌaleꞌ. As la ul in unpajte, tan la ul veqꞌo veꞌt ex, aqꞌal uvaꞌ katil uveꞌ la atinkat in as tzitziꞌ la atinkat ex,
tan ootzimaleꞌ setaꞌn uvaꞌ katiꞌch unbꞌeneꞌ. As ootzimal u bꞌeyeꞌ setaꞌn uveꞌ la bꞌenkat in,— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal u Maxh ileꞌ te u Jesús: —Pap, as yeꞌ qootzaj uvaꞌ katil la bꞌenkat axh. ¿As kam la qulbꞌe qootzit u bꞌeyeꞌ qꞌi?— tiꞌk naj.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Ineꞌ u bꞌeyeꞌ. As ineꞌ u jikla yoleꞌ. As ineꞌ u tiichajileꞌ, tan yeꞌxhebꞌil la uch tok kꞌatz vunBꞌaaleꞌ, asoj jit in la oksan kꞌatz Aak.

As kat koj bꞌen sete kam u vijleꞌmeꞌ, as la bꞌeneꞌ sete kam u tijleꞌm vunBꞌaaleꞌ unpajte. As cheel tuk etootzi veꞌt u tijleꞌm vunBꞌaaleꞌ, tan il in netil veꞌt in tan eela kuxh ineꞌ tukꞌ vunBꞌaaleꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt u Piꞌl ileꞌ: —Pap, kꞌuch u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ sqe. As kat ibꞌanleꞌ,— tiꞌk u Piꞌleꞌ.

As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Naꞌytzaneꞌ taꞌ, Piꞌl, vatin sexoꞌl. ¿As ma yeꞌ ootzit veꞌt u vijleꞌmeꞌ? Tan abꞌil uveꞌ kat ilon in, as aꞌ Kubꞌaaleꞌ kat tillaꞌ. ¿Kam qꞌi uvaꞌ naal veꞌt sve uvaꞌ: «Kꞌuch u Kubꞌaaleꞌ sqe,» chꞌaxh naaleꞌ?

¿Ma yeꞌ nanima uvaꞌ at in kꞌatz vunBꞌaaleꞌ, as at Aak sunkꞌatz? Tan jit vuntxumbꞌaleꞌ ni voksa tiꞌ valat unqꞌa yoleꞌ sete. Pet aꞌ vunBꞌaaleꞌ uveꞌ at sunkꞌatz as Aakeꞌ ni bꞌanon unqꞌa kꞌuchbꞌal tetz vibꞌaꞌnileꞌ sviꞌ.
Enimataj uvaꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ at in kꞌatz vunBꞌaaleꞌ, as at vunBꞌaaleꞌ sunkꞌatz. Pet asoj yeꞌ nenima in tiꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ni val sete, as enimataj in tiꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uveꞌ nunbꞌan sexoꞌl.

As jik chit tuk val sete, tan abꞌil uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl ikꞌuꞌl sviꞌ as la ibꞌan unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ. As la pal unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uveꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ tiꞌ uveꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ, tan tuk bꞌenoj in kꞌatz vunBꞌaaleꞌ.
As kam unqꞌa veeꞌ la ejaj te vunBꞌaaleꞌ tukꞌ vunbꞌiieꞌ as la unbꞌaneꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la unkꞌucheꞌ uvaꞌ nitoksal iqꞌii vunBꞌaaleꞌ taꞌn viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ.
As kam chit unqꞌa veeꞌ la ejaj tukꞌ vunbꞌiieꞌ, as la chit unbꞌaneꞌ.
Ni tal u Jesús uvaꞌ la ul u Tiixhla Espíritu
Asoj xoꞌn veꞌt in sete, as enimataj vuntzaqꞌiteꞌ.
As la unjaj bꞌaꞌnil te vunBꞌaaleꞌ tiꞌ taqꞌat tzan Aak umaꞌt u lochol etetz, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la atin veꞌt sexoꞌl tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ.

As aꞌeꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritu uvaꞌ la lochon ex tiꞌ etootzit isuuchil u yoleꞌ sviꞌ. As yeꞌ la uch tok kꞌatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ vatz txꞌavaꞌilla txumbꞌal vitxumbꞌaleꞌ, tan yeꞌxhkam ni tileꞌ as yeꞌxhkam ootzimal staꞌn. Pet ech koj ex, tan ootzimal veꞌt u Tiixhla Espíritu setaꞌn, tan at veꞌt sexoꞌl. As tuk atinoj veꞌt sekꞌatz.
As yeꞌl ex la koj chit velebꞌe kan ex. Pet latel ul in sekꞌatz.
Yeꞌxh jatvaꞌt qꞌii as yeꞌ la til veꞌt in unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌ ni niman in. Pet ech koj ex, tan la etil veꞌt in, tan isleꞌl in. As isleꞌl veꞌt ex sunkꞌatz la ibꞌaneꞌ.
As tu veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ as la etootzi veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ at in kꞌatz vunBꞌaaleꞌ. As at ex sunkꞌatz. As at in sekꞌatz.

As abꞌil uvaꞌ ootzimal veꞌt vuntzaqꞌiteꞌ staꞌn, as ninima, as aꞌeꞌ uveꞌ xoꞌn in ste. As abꞌil uveꞌ xoꞌn in ste as tuk xoꞌnilojeꞌ taꞌn vunBꞌaaleꞌ. As ineꞌ la xoꞌnin veꞌteꞌ. As la unkꞌuch vuntxumbꞌaleꞌ ste,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt u Judas uvaꞌ jit u Iscariote ech ileꞌ: —¿Pap, kam qꞌi uveꞌ aꞌ kuxh la akꞌuchkat vatxumbꞌaleꞌ sqe, as jit te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌ ni niman axh?— tiꞌk naj.
As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Abꞌil uvaꞌ la xoꞌnin veꞌt in as la inima veꞌt vunyoleꞌ, as xoꞌn veꞌteꞌ te vunBꞌaaleꞌ. As la ul veꞌt oꞌ skꞌatz; as la atin veꞌt oꞌ skꞌatz.
Pet abꞌil uveꞌ yeꞌ xoꞌn in ste, as yeꞌ ninima vunyoleꞌ. As tul jit kuxh vetzeꞌ u yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni valeꞌ. Pet tetz vunBꞌaaleꞌ unpajte, u chajol tzan vetzeꞌ.
As ni val unqꞌa txumbꞌaleꞌ sete, tan atiltel in sexoꞌl.

Pet la ul u lochol etetzeꞌ uvaꞌ Tiixhla Espíritu uveꞌ tuk ichaj tzan vunBꞌaaleꞌ, tukꞌ vunbꞌiieꞌ. As aꞌ veꞌteꞌ la chusun ex tiꞌ etootzit isuuchil unqꞌa veeꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ. As la tulsa veꞌt vunyoleꞌ sekꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ kat val sete.

As in kuxheꞌ la aqꞌon sete uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatin sevatzaj. As yeꞌ kuxh exaansa etaama, tan in kuxheꞌ la aqꞌon sete tiꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatin sevatzaj. As yeꞌ xoꞌv ex, tan jit eela uveꞌ tuk vaqꞌ sete tiꞌ uvaꞌ la taqꞌ unqꞌa vatz txꞌavaꞌilla txumbꞌaleꞌ sete.

As etabꞌileꞌ uvaꞌ kat val sete uvaꞌ la bꞌen in, as la qꞌaav veꞌt in sekꞌatz unpajte. Asoj an chittuꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌn in sete, as kat chiibꞌiy veꞌt exeꞌ taꞌ tiꞌ vunyoleꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌen in kꞌatz vunBꞌaaleꞌ, tan nim talcheꞌ vunBꞌaaleꞌ sviꞌ.
As bꞌaxel ni val kan unqꞌa yoleꞌ sete, aqꞌal uvaꞌ tul la bꞌen ibꞌaneꞌ, as la enima veꞌteꞌ.
As yeꞌ kuxh jankꞌat yol tuk val sete cheel, tan tul veꞌt vibꞌooqꞌol unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌ ni niman vunyoleꞌ. As tul nim talcheꞌ u vijleꞌmeꞌ stiꞌ.
As tuk chit unbꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ kat tal vunBꞌaaleꞌ sve, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la tootzi veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ skajayil uvaꞌ xoꞌn vunBꞌaaleꞌ sve. As txakpoj ex. Koꞌnaj veꞌteꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
